title.en: From Making It to Making It Last

summary.zh: 从十万人考研社群里的第一个产品，到伯克利的 demo day、回国后的投资分析，再到把研究和工作流都变成能跑起来的管线。一条还没走完的路。
summary.en: From a first product in a study community, to demo days at Berkeley and investment work back home, to pipelines that make research and workflow runnable. A path that is not finished.
